make.common:
CMS_DMP_FLAGS += -DSUPPORT_TR69C
endif

ifneq ($(strip $(BUILD_TR69_TR143)),)
ifneq ($(strip $(BUILD_TR98_PROFILES)),)
CMS_DMP_FLAGS += -DDMP_DOWNLOAD_1
CMS_DMP_FLAGS += -DSUPPORT_TR69C
endif

ifneq ($(strip $(BUILD_ICWMP)),)
# Open source CWMP client (userspace/public/apps/icwmp) replaces tr69c as the
# process launched by tr69_md (SUPPORT_ICWMP in comp_tr69_md.c).  It needs
# libuci, libmicroxml and libtr098 (userspace/public/libs) on top of the
# ubus/json-c/curl/openssl stack already selected by the TR69C flags.
CMS_DMP_FLAGS += -DSUPPORT_ICWMP
BUILD_LIBUCI=y
BUILD_LIBMICROXML=y
BUILD_LIBTR098=y
BUILD_LIBCURL=y
BUILD_ZLIB=y
export BUILD_ICWMP BUILD_LIBUCI BUILD_LIBMICROXML BUILD_LIBTR098
endif

ifneq ($(strip $(BUILD_TR69_TR143)),)
ifneq ($(strip $(BUILD_TR98_PROFILES)),)
CMS_DMP_FLAGS += -DDMP_DOWNLOAD_1
